In summary, our research is concerned with
the control of StGA20OX1 transcript levels and the role of the gene product in the control of plant growth and development.
the regulation of the transcript levels of StGA 20-oxidases in potato.
the regulation of a GA biosynthetic enzyme gene in response to light and the possible involvement of PHYB and a blue light receptor in the control of the gene.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
StGA20OX1 expression is controlled by phytochrome B and is up-regulated by blue light.
the light regulation of StGA20OX1 transcript levels is independent of phytochrome and that the light regulation is not mediated by phytochrome.
the expression of StGA20 is regulated by light, phytochrome, and possibly blue light receptors, and that phytochromes A and B are both involved in the regulation of StGA20 expression by light.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the StGA20ox gene is regulated by phytochrome, and by a light receptor that is distinct from phytochrome.
the expression of StGA20 is under the control of both phytochrome and blue light receptors.
the expression of StGA20 ox1 is regulated by light and phyB and the gene may be regulated by a blue light receptor.
The main takeaway from our work is that
StGA20-ox1 transcript levels in potato leaves are regulated by PHYB and that StGA20Ox1 is up-regulated by blue and red light.
the expression of StGA20 is controlled by light, and phytochrome, which may be important in controlling the level of GA in the plant.
StGA20oxidase transcript levels are regulated by both light and phytochromes.
